_comments: THE PAYMENT-GATED ACCESS ACTION (bc-aidp-next-golive#223). Its own dot-json so parallel work on
WHY AN ACTION. A renewal passes its cutoff with nothing being written, so the payment path cannot
catch it; MJ's scheduler dispatches Actions, and this row is how the nightly job reaches
EnforcePaymentGatedAccess. The class behind it holds no access logic.
SAFE TO SHIP Active: nothing invokes it until the ScheduledJob in metadata/scheduled-jobs/ is
enabled, and that job ships Disabled and set to Preview.

fields.Name: Enforce Payment-Gated Access
fields.Description: Suspend the OnFirstPayment grants of renewal orders that are past the configured cutoff (the RenewalAccessCutoffDaysPastDue setting), and restore any payment-suspended grant whose payment has since arrived. Preview reports what would change without writing anything.
fields.UserPrompt: Suspend access on renewals past due beyond the cutoff and restore access that has since been paid, or preview what would change.

fields.Name: AsOfDate
fields.Description: Treat this date as today when measuring days past due (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for the business day, which is what the schedule uses. An unreadable value is refused rather than replaced with today.

fields.Name: Preview
fields.Description: True reports what WOULD change and writes nothing; false (the default) writes the changes. A value that is neither is refused rather than guessed.

fields.Name: MaxCount
fields.Description: Cap on orders processed in one pass. Orders left over are processed on the next pass. A value that is not a whole number of at least 1 is refused.

fields.Name: Activated
fields.Description: How many grants this pass moved to Active (or would, on a preview).

fields.Name: Suspended
fields.Description: How many grants this pass moved to Suspended (or would, on a preview).

fields.Name: Changes
fields.Description: Every grant changed or to be changed: the order, the grant, the status and reason before and after, and the days past due.

fields.Name: Failures
fields.Description: Orders whose re-decision failed, with the error. Each failed order was rolled back on its own; the rest of the pass stands.

fields.Name: PreviewedOnly
fields.Description: True when this pass reported its list and wrote nothing. Not named Preview, so the input's value is not overwritten.
